songs.name: Mirror
songs.lyrics:
had my breakfast at the window spitting pips into the wind 
(do you know the bittersweet taste of tangerines)
seventeen, or what's the time now? it’s hard to feel when it feels the same 
hung under I wonder about the gentle charm a bullet has 
heavy duty frown you’re dusty stunned under a ton of 
lead guess that outside smile turns rusty when the inside one is dead 
stumbled through the corridor door following a trace of folds 
here, somewhere, there or nowhere; am I worried or just logical? 
semidoubtful drown you're dusty so sorry about where this led 
when that outside smile turns rusty will it send me straight to bed? 
hello my friend I still depend on what you do for me so hard to find 
we had behind so many corners see
I'm glad I found you on the ground that I was hiding on
a mirror's gaze no secret days
secret two equals one

songs.name: Jukebox Scenario
songs.lyrics:
rain patters on the windshield, we're driving through the light of the night, you said the situation is pretty romantic but in a modern type – overtaken by a lorry, we’re listening to the secret stars 
you never said 'i’m sorry' (cause there was no reason, but believe me I'm sorry!)
space road ahead

songs.name: Smoke
songs.lyrics: what’s your interpretation of scent and sound?

songs.name: Destination: South Of France
songs.lyrics:
(LUV)
on the highway in a car we waited for hours 
didn't go to far 
the guy who gave us a lift was drunken as hell 
and didn't give a shit 
I hated that guy, I hated that car 
he was talking to us and spit ran out of his mouth and I looked out the window and thought about a place in the south 
and his words were like waves 
washing sand into my car 
he drove way too fast 
but I had no fear 
the only thing I wanted was to be there 
and I tried to remember 
and I put on that glare I guess 
that I was talking a little too much the time 
you told me just shut up 
you only wanted me to play my guitar 
so I did while I was dreaming of being your star

songs.name: Desert City
songs.lyrics:
I don’t know anybody else living life as fast as you do.
Somehow I love your style.
Remember the times that I cut your hair? I wanna do it again, make you look line Prince Charming again. You rock so hard you make mw wanna scream like the angle of longing, the only thing I'm scared of is that you're leaving Las Vegas and I don't even know why

songs.name: Another Teenage Story
songs.lyrics: the lamps now. they glitter down the street. faintly sound the falling feet. and the blue even slowly falls about the cars roofs and walls. he walks alone. his fingers shivering then he starts to run as fire paints his room red. burning pictures in his sunken head. and as he starts with scary eyes the sun shines and the lustre dies. all at once the gloom returns. blinking eyes tell him the truth what can do without you.

songs.name: Nothing New
songs.lyrics:
it’s all been said before, nothing new, nothing complicated, just common sense. 
once more we are stretching out our hands to the enemy, accepting their way of life. 
once more we are stretching out our hands to the enemy, accepting their way of thinking. 
and finally we are even accepting everything we did to kick down people that we're trying to hold us back. holger ohst
